title: CyberWolf Blue Team Check
description: Questions about log analysis, evidence and incident triage.

questions.prompt: Why should an analyst record the time zone when building an incident timeline?

options.text: Time zones are always identical across systems
Events may be recorded in different time zones or clock settings
A time zone reveals the user's password
Timestamps cannot be used in investigations

questions.explanation: Systems can use different time zones, daylight-saving settings or clocks. Normalization and documentation help avoid incorrect event ordering.

questions.prompt: What should a good alert triage note do?

options.text: State assumptions as confirmed facts
Record evidence, context, uncertainty and next steps
Delete the original logs
Name an attacker without supporting evidence

questions.explanation: Useful triage separates what telemetry shows from hypotheses, notes limitations and recommends proportionate next steps.

questions.prompt: What is a false positive in security monitoring?

options.text: A true malicious event that was detected
A benign event incorrectly flagged as suspicious
An event with a valid timestamp
A log source that is encrypted

questions.explanation: A false positive occurs when benign activity is classified as suspicious. Analysts tune detections while ensuring they do not hide meaningful malicious activity.

questions.prompt: Why is evidence preservation important during incident response?

options.text: It makes every investigation conclusive
It helps maintain integrity and supports later analysis
It eliminates the need for documentation
It guarantees attribution

questions.explanation: Preserving originals, recording hashes and documenting handling supports integrity and repeatable analysis. It does not guarantee that every question can be answered.

questions.prompt: What should guide an incident containment decision?

options.text: The first tool recommendation regardless of business impact
Scope, evidence, risk, business impact and the response plan
A desire to delete all logs
An assumption that every alert is critical

questions.explanation: Containment should be proportionate, authorized and coordinated with the incident response plan, considering operational impact and evidence needs.
